description:
Pay {1} and tap Retrofitter Foundry to create a 1/1 Servo token.
Sacrifice Retrofitter Foundry to Krark-Clan Ironworks to add {C}{C}.
Sacrifice a Servo to Krark-Clan Ironworks to add {C}{C}.
Pay {1} to put a charge counter on Gemstone Array.
Remove the charge counter from Gemstone Array to add {W}.
Pay {W} to Auriok Salvagers to return Retrofitter Foundry from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Retrofitter Foundry for {1}.
Repeat.
